name: unsafe fn read_volatile < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: If `T` is not `Copy`, using both the returned value and the value at `*src` can violate memory safety, because `read_volatile` creates a bitwise copy regardless of whether `T` is `Copy`.
api: unsafe fn read_volatile < T > (src : * const T) -> T
expression: The requirement is not expressible in this DSL: neither `T: Copy` nor subsequent use of both values is observable.
